description: Biological category taxonomy for V2 Signal Registry. Each signal must declare exactly one category. Categories are the orthogonal grouping used by Pathway Activation, Cause Ranker, and Recovery Modifier engines.

categories.label: Hair Loss Pattern
categories.purpose: Observable shedding morphology and progression descriptors. Drives pattern-vs-diffuse differentiation.

categories.label: Scalp State
categories.purpose: Raw scalp condition observations (oil, dryness, flaking, lesions). Precursor to inflammation derivations.

categories.label: Inflammation
categories.purpose: Derived inflammatory state signals — composites of scalp observations and immune history.

categories.label: Sebum Regulation
categories.purpose: Sebaceous activity dysregulation relevant to follicular microenvironment and androgen response.

categories.label: Hormonal Indicators
categories.purpose: Endocrine state observations: thyroid, reproductive axis, life-stage transitions.

categories.label: Metabolic Indicators
categories.purpose: Insulin/glucose axis, adiposity, and substrate-availability observations.

categories.label: Nutritional Indicators
categories.purpose: Substrate-deficit observations: deficiencies, dietary patterns affecting micronutrient availability.

categories.label: Stress Indicators
categories.purpose: HPA-axis and psychogenic observations relevant to telogen disruption.

categories.label: Lifestyle Indicators
categories.purpose: Exposures and behaviors that act as recovery modifiers (smoking, alcohol, shift, travel).

categories.label: Immune Indicators
categories.purpose: Autoimmune, allergic, and inflammatory comorbidity observations.

categories.label: Gut-Hair Axis Indicators
categories.purpose: GI symptoms relevant to absorption, microbiome, and systemic inflammation contribution.

categories.label: Treatment History
categories.purpose: Extrinsic exposures (heat, chemical, hard water) relevant to shaft integrity.

categories.label: Etiology Markers
categories.purpose: Self-reported cause attributions: genetics, illness, GLP-1, post-partum etc.

categories.label: Demographic Modifiers
categories.purpose: Age band, sex, goal — modifiers used by priors and recovery calibration.

categories.label: Recovery Modifiers
categories.purpose: Signals that directly modulate recovery ceiling, responsiveness, or progression risk.

categories.label: Adherence Risks
categories.purpose: Observations predictive of protocol-adherence difficulty: irregular routine, complex comorbidity, behavioral patterns.

categories.label: Progression Risks
categories.purpose: Observations elevating risk of continued deterioration absent intervention (grade severity, chronic duration, family history).
